description: Roxy-BlenderMCP, an independently maintained fork of MCP for Blender, for Codex (not affiliated with the Blender Foundation).

author.name: Roxy-BlenderMCP (based on MCP for Blender by Siddharth Ahuja)

interface.longDescription: An independently maintained fork of the open-source MCP for Blender. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Blender Foundation. Connects Codex to a running Blender through the Roxy Blender MCP addon. Create and edit objects, materials and lighting, pull free assets from Poly Haven, Sketchfab and Poly Pizza with a visual picker, @-mention scene objects, and watch the viewport beside the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Add a wooden chair from Poly Pizza
